We replace fragmented legacy software and manual spreadsheets with a unified system spanning estimating, project management, engineering, production, shipping, and accounting. Role Overview We are looking for a 100% remote Implementation Project Manager – ERP & Accounting to lead our clients through onboarding, financial configuration, and go-live on the CastLogic platform. CastLogic is already built—your job is to get our clients successfully running on it. Because financial accuracy is the hardest and most critical part of any ERP transition, we aren't looking for a software engineer or a coder. We are looking for someone who speaks the language of accounting fluently, understands the day-to-day reality and mindset of an accounting team, and knows exactly how operational transactions flow into the General Ledger (GL) in major ERPs like NetSuite, Oracle, or SAP. You will own the client implementation lifecycle from kickoff to post-go-live handoff, working remotely alongside clients across North America during standard PST or EST business hours to ensure every Chart of Accounts, job-costing structure, and external accounting integration is dialed in for a clean close. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Client Implementations: Lead precast concrete manufacturers through structured remote onboarding milestones—from initial discovery and data migration to parallel testing, go-live, and transition to ongoing support. Financial & GL Configuration: Configure client accounting workflows inside CastLogic, mapping operational events (purchasing, inventory consumption, production labor, freight, AP/AR, and AIA progress billing) to the proper General Ledger accounts. Accounting Standards & Job Costing Setup: Guide client Controllers and accounting teams in setting up Work-in-Progress (WIP) tracking, cost codes, inventory valuation, and revenue recognition workflows in compliance with US GAAP and IFRS. External ERP Integrations & Reconciliations: Oversee accounting data syncs and chart-of-accounts mappings between CastLogic and external accounting platforms (such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Sage, and QuickBooks), ensuring sub-ledgers tie out cleanly. Data Migration & Opening Balances: Partner with clients to clean, validate, and import historical financial data, open AP/AR invoices, active job budgets, and opening trial balances. Client Training & Change Management: Train Controllers, bookkeepers, and AP/AR clerks on daily and month-end accounting workflows inside CastLogic, earning their trust and helping them transition off legacy habits. Issue Triage & Escalation Management: Diagnose client-reported accounting discrepancies (e.g., posting errors, job-cost variances, or sync mismatches), resolving configuration issues directly and escalating true software bugs cleanly to engineering. Qualifications Strong Accounting Foundation: Solid working knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, with hands-on experience in manufacturing, construction, or project-based accounting (e.g., job costing, WIP, percentage-of-completion billing, and inventory accounting). Enterprise ERP Experience: Experience working inside, administering, or implementing major ERP systems such as NetSuite, Oracle, or SAP. You intuitively understand debits/credits, sub-ledger-to-GL posting rules, posting periods, and audit trails. Accounting Team Empathy: You understand how accounting teams operate under pressure—especially around month-end close, reconciliations, and audits—and know how to guide them through system changes calmly and clearly. Remote Project Management Discipline: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent client implementations in a remote environment, hold stakeholders accountable to timelines, run crisp training sessions, and keep rollouts on schedule. Schedule Availability: Ability to work a full-time remote schedule aligned with PST or EST business hours to support clients and collaborate with the IntraSync team. Non-Technical Clarity: You do not need to write code, but you must be analytically sharp, comfortable working with CSV imports/data mappings, and able to explain how software workflows impact financial statements. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have) Background as an ERP Implementation Consultant, Systems Accountant, Controller, Accounting Manager, or Senior Accountant. CPA, CMA, or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Information Systems. Familiarity with precast concrete, building materials, or heavy manufacturing operations. Compensation & Work Setup Pay Range: $20.00 – $40.00 per hour, based on relevant ERP, GAAP/IFRS, and implementation experience. Work Environment: 100% remote position with schedule alignment to PST or EST business hours.
